spans.s:
उर्णनाभ m. (-भः) A spider.
 E. उर्ण wool, नाभि a navel, affix ड.

ऊर्णनाभ m. (-भः) A spider.
 E. ऊर्ण wool, नाभि the navel, ड affix; also
ऊर्णनाभि, the final being retained.

उर्णा f. (-र्णा)
 1. Wool, felt, the hair of camels, &c.
 2. A circle of hair
between the eyebrows.
 E. उर्णु to cover, ड affix; the word is proper-
ly ऊर्णा, q. v.

ऊर्णा f. (-र्णा)
 1. Wool, felt, &c., the hair of sheep, deer, camels, &c.
 2.
A circle of the hair between the eyebrows, considered as a token
of greatness.
 E. ऊर्णु to cover, ड and टाप् affs.

ऊर्णामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Woolen, made of wool.
 E. ऊर्णा and मयट् aff.

ऊर्णायु m. (-युः)
 1. A woollen blanket.
 2. A ram.
 3. A spider.
 E. ऊर्णा
wool, युस् aff.

ऊर्णु r. 2nd cl. (ञ) ऊर्णुञ् (ऊर्णौति ऊर्णोति or ऊर्णुते) To cover, hide, con-
ceal, &c. with प्र prefixed प्रोर्णौति.

ऊर्णुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered.
 E. ऊर्णु and क्त aff.
